shared_elements: shallow low-relief curvilinear motifs carved on a rough stone surface
long straight or slightly curved linear bands
clustered, non-narrative arrangement of separate abstract signs
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow, schematic low-relief signs of the same general vocabulary — crescent/hook-shaped curvilinear forms combined with long straight linear bands, scattered as discrete motifs rather than a narrative scene — and the depth and simplification conventions are comparable. However, no single motif can be matched between them in form or in relation to its neighbours: A's marks are loose, isolated hooks and blobs spread over an irregular field, while B's are organised symmetrically about a vertical axis with paired long verticals flanking a large central arc, suggesting a deliberate composition absent in A.
